label: Treasure
tooltip: Coffer overlays and Treasure Hunt routing.

draw_line_to_bronze_chests.label: Draw lines to bronze coffers
draw_line_to_bronze_chests.tooltip: Render a brown line from your character to nearby bronze coffers, while out of combat.

draw_line_to_silver_chests.label: Draw lines to silver coffers
draw_line_to_silver_chests.tooltip: Render a silver line from your character to nearby silver coffers, while out of combat.

draw_line_to_carrots.label: Draw lines to carrots
draw_line_to_carrots.tooltip: Render a green line from your character to nearby carrots, while out of combat.

show_percentage_active_treasure_count.label: Show active treasure as percentage
show_percentage_active_treasure_count.tooltip: Show active treasure as percentage next to the total

enable_treasure_hunt.label: Show Treasure Hunt button
enable_treasure_hunt.tooltip: Show the treasure hunt button in the main window.

return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.label: Return after hunt
return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.tooltip: Cast Return to base camp after the last coffer on the route.

play_sound_on_hunt_complete.label: Play sound when hunt finishes
play_sound_on_hunt_complete.tooltip: Play an MP3 when Treasure Hunt completes.

hunt_complete_sound.label: Hunt complete sound
hunt_complete_sound.tooltip: MP3 from the plugin Sounds folder. Click an option to preview.
hunt_complete_sound.open_folder: Open sound folder — drop MP3s here to add your own.

cast_treasure_sight_during_hunt.label: Cast Treasure Sight during hunt
cast_treasure_sight_during_hunt.tooltip: Cast Treasure Sight when the hunt starts (and again periodically). Ends the hunt early when Sight reports no remaining coffers.

hunt_return_cost.label: Return cost
hunt_return_cost.tooltip: Pathfinding cost weight for returning to base camp

hunt_teleport_cost.label: Teleport cost
hunt_teleport_cost.tooltip: Pathfinding cost weight for aethernet teleports

hunt_detection_range.label: Detection range
hunt_detection_range.tooltip: How close you must be to a chest node before interacting

hunt_max_level.label: Max chest level
hunt_max_level.tooltip: Maximum treasure node level to include in the hunt route

skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.label: Skip unsafe treasure windows
skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.tooltip: Pause Treasure Hunt during South Horn Ashkin / dangerous weather windows.
